'''Jaris Vollrath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who worked as an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Vollrath was hired by the [[Thaereian military]] to kill [[Gavid Lermyn]], a Thaereian diplomat who hoped to bring peace to [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. He attempted to kill Lermyn at a secret peace conference in [[Hiironi irstat]], on Cularin. However, the [[Heroes of Cularin]] stopped him from doing so.
